args.title: Make error toasts assertive and non-auto-dismissing
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts (item.kind === "error") should be announced via an assertive live region (e.g. a separate container or role="alert"/aria-live="assertive") instead of sharing the single role="status" aria-live="polite" container used for all toasts. Also, the setTimeout auto-dismiss should be skipped/disabled for error toasts so they remain visible until the user dismisses them, rather than disappearing after AUTO_DISMISS_MS like success/info toasts.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

All toasts, including errors, are rendered in a single role="status" aria-live="polite" region and always auto-dismiss via setTimeout, so error toasts are announced politely and vanish after a few seconds like any other toast. Error toasts should use an assertive live region and skip auto-dismiss so they persist until manually dismissed.
